title: Green Witch by Candlelight
description: A green-skinned woman with long dark hair sits barefoot on a blue chaise lounge, holding a lit red candle that drips wax. She is draped in a dark patterned shawl with skull and floral motifs, under a blue umbrella decorated with spiders, while a snowy icy landscape is visible through a cracked arched window behind her.
prompt: A green-skinned witch with long dark hair sits barefoot on an ornate blue chaise lounge in a dark room, holding a tall red dripping candle with a bright flame. She wears a sheer dress and a long dark shawl covered in skulls, flowers, and insects. A large blue umbrella with spider patterns hovers above her. Behind her an arched window reveals a cracked icy wasteland with stalactites at sunset. Black melted wax drips from the windowsill where another candelabra sits. Cobblestones on the floor, atmospheric glowing orbs, dark fantasy style, detailed illustration
